tool_args.rationale: The signatures and concave response favor the sink-modulated hydraulic-basin law over the recalled no-sink alternatives, but the current paired changes in u_now and s_grad do not identify the sink effect independently. Acquire a high-s_grad observation to test that dependence before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary u_now and s_grad together, so their effects are confounded; the source note also leaves a branch term unspecified.
The observed H already matches the target forecast horizon; a high-s_grad regime point is more discriminating for the sink-gradient mechanism.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
